targets.old_statement: Crashed vehicles must be moved off the main roadway only when nobody suffered serious physical injury or death, and only if they can run under their own power.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Crashed vehicles must be moved off the main roadway only when nobody suffered serious physical injury or death, and only if they can run under their own power.
targets.statement: When a crash involves no serious physical injury or death, vehicles must be removed from the main traveled roadway if they remain safely operable under their own power without needing towing and moving them will not cause further vehicle damage or increase traffic hazards.

targets.old_statement: A complaint about an officer's conduct goes to the officer's agency, where you can ask for a supervisor, ideally soon after the stop.
